3) Aditya — once we have the mapping, please prepare the reversing entries in NetSuite and attach JNL-2025-089 to the record. I put a draft of the journal in the attached PDF for review.

Attachments: AR_aging_20251101.xlsx (breakdown), JNL-2025-089.pdf (draft), VAT_reclaim_form_BrightCore.pdf (customer-submitted).

Thanks — let's aim to close this before the end of the week; this is blocking collection on ~60k of the outstanding balance.

Monica — thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. Quick notes after a first pass:

- The July credit (INV-20250720-CRT) was issued to correct a double-billing on a support add-on; the original revenue for that add-on was recognized in July (Q3). The credit reverses recognized revenue, so technically revrec should be adjusted back to July (we will post a reversing revenue entry to the July GL and apply the credit there).
- If BrightCore insists VAT was not due on the credit, we still need to reverse the VAT amount in our VAT payable account and prepare the reclaim evidence. The VAT reclaim form attached looks complete but Marissa should validate the customer's proof of refund.
- Proposed mapping (high-level) — Revenue (4000) reduction; Deferred revenue (2300) check; VAT payable (2100) adjustment. I'll produce the GL-level mapping and line numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Two small asks: please include the customer's credit note PDF if you have it in the Share drive link, and Aditya — hold off on posting the reversing journal until I post my detailed mapping post (so we don't mis-code the line).
